## 2026

- Currently organizing a 1-day event in November 2026 titled "[Lessons from and beyond the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF)](Lessons%20frohttps://ose.be/en/events/fiscal-and-budgetary-policy-for-social-europe/m%20and%20beyond%20the%20Recovery%20and%20Resilience%20Facility%20(RRF))" for EU and national policymakers in collaboration with the European Social Observatory (OSE) on socio-economic reforms in the [National Recovery and Resilience Plans](https://reforms-investments.ec.europa.eu/technical-support-instrument-0/recovery-and-resilience-plans_en) and the [National Medium-term Fiscal-structural Plans](https://economy-finance.ec.europa.eu/economic-governance-framework/stability-and-growth-pact/preventive-arm/national-medium-term-fiscal-structural-plans_en).
